note: Read-only Canon rule index (MVP). Rules are conformant to canon-rule.schema.json. Adapted from docs/TerraCanon reference package and aligned to the CURRENT repo (os-canon shell launch drift already resolved). Gate ids match gate-registry.json.

rules.title: os-canon must open inside the OS shell
rules.description: Canon is an OS Feature. It must open as an in-shell, near-full-stage OS feature window via activateModule; Dock and Top Bar stay visible. Full-page route navigation is product-architecture drift. (Already satisfied on origin/main; this rule guards against regression.)

rules.title: Launch-surface contract test is the shell contract gate
rules.description: The repo-native launch-surface contract test is the authoritative implementation of the shell launch-surface gate for os-canon/os-pilot/os-trace. It is stronger than the package stub and must not be overwritten.

rules.title: os-canon UI lives under os-shell canon/module areas
rules.description: The existing frontend/apps/os-shell/src/canon area and the reserved modules/os-canon area are owned by os-canon. Package UI skeletons must reconcile with these, not overwrite them.

rules.title: Canon Runtime is OS-platform-owned
rules.description: The Canon Runtime query layer is read-only, deterministic, and OS-platform-owned. No agent execution, no command execution, no file editing from this layer.

rules.title: TerraCanon docs are inert reference
rules.description: docs/TerraCanon holds reference doctrine and the imported development package. It is documentation, not runtime; low risk, no gates.
